verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents executing custom JS and waiting for async content before extraction (gh-21). It also simulates scrolling for infinite-scroll pages (gh-25) and offers hooks and session reuse for multi-step browser control (docs-6, gh-18). Together these cover scripting page interactions before content is returned, though clicking and filling inputs are only implied by JS execution. missing for 10: explicit documentation of click and input-fill actions, a concrete interaction-scripting example, independent hands-on corroboration.
